2. White card: small food thumbnail, "Cơm tấm sườn nướng · Bếp Nhà 24", and the hot-pink band "Lấy 20:00–21:00 · Hôm nay"; below it "Tầng 4, Tasco Mall".
3. Section "Số lượng" with a stepper "− 2 +" and the hint "Còn 3 phần".
4. Section "Cách nhận": a single selected radio "Đến lấy tại quầy" and a disabled row "Giao hàng · sắp có".
5. Section "Thanh toán" with two radio rows: "Tiền mặt khi đến lấy" and "Chuyển khoản VietQR" (selected) with a small QR icon.

7. Small grey line: "Đơn được giữ 15 phút để bạn chuyển khoản."

Page ground: light kraft-paper brown #CDAA7D with a very faint paper-fibre texture, used ONLY as the page background. Cards and sheets: clean white #FFFFFF with 16px radius and a soft shadow. Text: near-black ink #1C1A17, secondary grey #6B635A. ONE saturated accent only: a hot-pink rubber band #E2457A. THE SIGNATURE MOVE: each offer or order card carries exactly one thin rubber-band strap (about 28px tall, slightly glossy elastic texture, very slight wrap curve at the card edges) that crosses ONLY the card's text column, never the food photo; the band holds the pickup window and portions left in bold white condensed sans, e.g. "20:00–21:00 · còn 3". When sold out the band is grey and reads "Đã hết". Standard controls (chips, search field, tabs, buttons, steppers), aligned grid, generous touch targets. Real appetising photos of Vietnamese takeaway food (cơm tấm in a kraft box, bánh mì, gỏi cuốn on banana leaf, xôi, bread). Render the page itself edge to edge: no device frame, no browser window, no hand, no desk. Render all text exactly as written, with correct Vietnamese diacritics. No ratings, no invented statistics, no partner logos, no mascots.
